section.heading: Business Activity Tax information and process report.

para.text: No later than January 31, 2027, the Chief Financial Officer shall submit a report to the Mayor and the Council that contains the following information:

An analysis of the District's existing tax data that identifies gaps in information, such as business types that are missing from the District's tax forms, necessary to estimate the revenues associated with the implementation of a Business Activity Tax;
The process by which the Office of the Chief Financial Officer proposes to undertake estimating revenues associated with the implementation of a Business Activity Tax, including:
The process to gather any missing data through informational returns or the expansion of existing returns;
Any legislative language or requirements necessary to effectuate informational returns and data collection;
The timeline and costs to implement an informational return or similar process sufficient to estimate revenues associated with the implementation of a Business Activity Tax;
An evaluation of taxes similar to a Business Activity Tax that have been implemented in other jurisdictions, including:
The volatility of the revenue collected from the tax; and
Challenges associated with administering the tax; and
Legal considerations associated with the implementation of a Business Activity Tax in the District.

For purposes of this section, the term "Business Activity Tax" means a tax on gross receipts of every business with a substantial nexus in the District, which shall be calculated by subtracting the sum of purchases from other businesses, rent, and capital expenditures from gross receipts that exceed $200,000.
